items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1961-05-22
items.q: I played drums once or twice with him.

ctx.x: Well who played with Jack Carey? Who was some of the other guys?
I don't know much about, I do know a little. I played drums once or twice with him. I saw Mutt Carey, I know he used to be the trumpet man. And Hunter Gaudet, he played with Jack.

items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1958-12-22
items.q: I was in the band with Jack Perry. Man, it's been so long.

ctx.x: What? When somebody tells me one thing, you know, I never know. Yeah. It might have been before my time. Before my time. So you mentioned Jack Perry. Man, it's been so long. You played drums or? I played drums. Yeah. Was Punch playing with him? Yeah. Was Punch playing with him? Yeah. Yeah.
I was in the band with Jack Perry. Man, it's been so long. You played drums or?
